newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres sets 9.15 bln peso investments.
newsitem.headline: Benpres sets 9.15 bln peso investments.

text.p: Conglomerate Benpres Holdings Corp said on Wednesday it would invest 9.15 billion pesos worth of equities in its subsidiaries and affiliates.

In a report to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the Lopez family-controlled company said it would allocate three billion pesos for Bayan Telecommunications Holdings Corp (Bayantel) or 33 percent of the proceeds from its rights offer.
Benpres is set to offer a two-for-five rights at seven pesos per share.
Bayantel has been the biggest recipient of Benpres' equity investments since 1994, receiving 1.78 billion pesos so far.
The energy-based First Philippine Holdings Corp would get 1.04 billion pesos, while real estate arm Rockwell Land Corp would get 1.35 billion pesos.
Its banking subsidiary, Philippine Commercial International Bank, would receive 2.06 billion pesos, while cable operator Sky Vision Corp would get 600 million pesos.
The First Philippine Infrastructure Development Corp is set to receive 150 million pesos. The newly-created waterworks company would get 950 million pesos.
Out of the 9.15 billion peso new investment, Lopez Inc, Benpres' parent company, is expected to pour in 4.05 billion pesos by subscribing to the new shares via a debt-for-equity swap.
